name: GeoMap
description: Points with a status anywhere in the world, clustered with a status ring, over a token-themed vector basemap with the home region glowing in the data hue.
signature: <T>({ label, config, home, regions, points, loading, frame: frameProp, frameKey, selectedId, onSelect, renderPopup, renderClusterPopup, pulses, statusLabels, noun, view, onViewChange, list, insets, className, }: GeoMapProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: config
props.description: Typed component configuration and external provider definitions.

props.name: frame
props.description: Frame the home region (default) or the points.

props.name: frameKey
props.description: Re-frame when this changes (a new scope, a new home region).

props.name: home
props.description: The home region: undefined while it loads, null when there is none.

props.name: insets
props.description:
Page chrome floating over a full-bleed map, in CSS pixels (a header above, a status strip
below): controls, credits and every frame stay clear of it, and it re-frames when it
changes. `null` means "being measured": the silhouette stays transparent until the insets
are known, so a server-rendered frame never paints in the wrong place and then jumps (CLS).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the map: "Sites, All organisations".

props.name: list
props.description: The list view: the caller's table, with a ViewToggle in its toolbar.

props.name: loading
props.description: The points are still loading: the silhouette stays, markers wait.

props.name: noun
props.description: Singular and plural names used in counts and accessible labels.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when select occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called when view change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: points
props.description: Geographical or chart points.

props.name: pulses
props.description: Per point, a counter that changes when its status changes: the marker pulses once.

props.name: regions
props.description: Other regions to outline faintly (the regions that hold points).

props.name: renderClusterPopup
props.description: Renders details for an aggregate map cluster.

props.name: renderPopup
props.description: Renders details for an individual map point.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Stable identifier of the selected item.

props.name: statusLabels
props.description: Display and accessible labels for the supported statuses.

props.name: view
props.description: "map" (default) or "list": the list replaces the map in the same box.
